INC-01_LATENCY_SPIKE.symptom: Live p95 latency exceeds 15ms continuously for > 30s
triage_steps: 1. Check pod CPU and memory utilization in Grafana dashboard.
2. Inspect garbage collection frequency and ONNX thread pool saturation.
3. If latency exceeds 50ms, trigger hot-swap rollback to v7.0-bmr-36f.

INC-02_PREDICTION_DRIFT.symptom: Calibrated fraud probability PSI exceeds 0.10 (Warning) or 0.25 (Critical)
triage_steps: 1. Check if novel merchant or affiliate has been onboarded in the last 24h.
3. Check for coordinated credential stuffing / bot attack.
INC-02_PREDICTION_DRIFT.mitigation_command: Enable secondary bot verification; do NOT retrain without 30-day verified chargeback data.

INC-03_CHECKSUM_TAMPER.symptom: Model artifact SHA-256 does not match certified manifest
triage_steps: 1. Immediately isolate affected container from load balancer.
2. Check container filesystem audit logs for unauthorized file modifications.
3. Re-deploy container from verified immutable image tag.
INC-03_CHECKSUM_TAMPER.mitigation_command: docker restart ropus-ml-service && verify SHA-256 matches d473d1ef0c50f232...

INC-04_HTTP_5XX_SURGE.symptom: HTTP 500 error rate exceeds 0.1% of total traffic
triage_steps: 1. Inspect error stack traces in service logs for unhandled feature preprocessing exceptions.
2. Check database connectivity for device feature lookups.
3. Fallback to static rule heuristic if ML service remains unresponsive.

INC-05_ADVERSARIAL_PAYLOAD.symptom: Surge of HTTP 422 schema validation failures or negative amount inputs
triage_steps: 1. Check gateway rate-limiter for aggressive single-IP probing.
2. Verify API schema sanitization blocks malformed types at the boundary.
3. Blacklist suspicious IP CIDR blocks at edge CDN/WAF.
